$comment: Copy to canonical/governance.json and edit. Every section is optional.
generated[] - files rendered from canonical sources. Editing the target
directly is drift, caught by rule MR003.
mirrors[]   - path groups that must stay byte-identical. `source` is the
authoritative copy; `studio sync` pushes it to the others and
rule MR001 fails when they diverge.
vendored[]  - content installed from elsewhere. Findings there are reported
but never block, because editing it is undone on upgrade.
waivers[]   - findings acknowledged and not being fixed, each with a reason.
A waiver is a decision on the record, not a mute button.
`~` is expanded. Relative paths in `sources` resolve from the repo root.

vendored.reason: Copied from upstream and re-copied on upgrade, so edits here do not persist.

waivers.reason: Vendor skill; splitting it is undone by the next upgrade. Tracked upstream.
